claim: The Elastic Overlapping Grid genuine overlap matching produces a measurable transport advantage in a discrete-time coined quantum walk.
domain: quantum walks / discrete-time coined walk on C_R box C_w
verdict_plain: The genuine matching is not special. It was outperformed by 94 of 100 deliberately wrong rewirings.

criterion_satisfiability.detail: Frozen criterion 3 requires per-grid positive fraction > 3/5. A proven parity selection rule caps it at 23/47 = 0.4894 and 31/63 = 0.4921 on the two doubly even held-out grids, at any horizon or parameter. Criterion 2 also fails at even horizon. Unreachable by construction, independent of mechanism quality.

control_ranking.detail: Genuine matching ranked 95 of 101 families on development aggregate median, the 6th percentile. 94 controls scored higher. 80 beat it on median and feasibility simultaneously. Protocol required rank <= 10; failed by 85 places.

effect_size_triage.detail: Measured effect 0.0006 to 0.0024 in probability against a declared tail gate of 0.02, a thirty-fold mismatch. Not estimated before the laboratory was built; this was the root planning error.

independent_reconstruction.detail: Independent verifier imports no producer evolution code and reconstructs every lift, quantile, positive count, rank and threshold decision, comparing the canonical summary byte for byte. Numerical invariants: max norm drift 1.9984014443252818e-15, probability-bound error 0, direct/derived amplitude error 2.2204460492503131e-16.

holdout_discipline.detail: lock_accesses=0 and heldout_accesses=0. The held-out set was never touched, so the falsification cost no holdout budget and the data remains usable.

structural_no_go_theorems: Candidate 1 rejected: development tail q10 -0.020494795710597848 below frozen -0.02 floor.
Candidate 2 not promoted: best feasible effect too small, selection would have been on discovery data.
Candidate 3: quotient lift is label-degenerate; separation required artificial fingerprints or pendant anchors.
Candidate 4: equal-layer double cover forces even nullity, so exact nullity one is impossible.
Candidate 5: passed zero-mode and 357-case non-isomorphism gates, then failed the strict endpoint quotient because endpoint-seeded refinement is discrete.
Candidate 6: canonical Hodge-Dirac incidence gives nullity n+7, and native plaquettes still leave nullity 9.
generalizable_findings: Permuting a matching is close to a relabelling, so candidate and controls are near-identical systems and no observable has much to detect.
A discriminator common to candidate and controls cannot separate them under any analytic function of the Hamiltonian.
Strict quotient compressibility and control distinguishability pull against each other; satisfying both forces artificial structure.
Position colour (r+c) mod 2 is exactly conserved iff both R and w are even, producing a selection rule that can penalise the very mechanism under test.
Known quantum-walk speedups arise from engineered graphs such as glued trees, not from naturally occurring data-structure graphs.

laboratory.environment: digest-pinned Linux/amd64 image, CPython 3.13.7, NumPy 2.4.2, single-threaded pools

boundary: Falsifies the declared operator class on development data. Does not invalidate quantum walks, does not invalidate EOG as a classical data structure, and asserts no advantage, novelty, hardware value or commercial claim. Never published, advertised or submitted to any funder.
